designs.name: Floral Spray
designs.summary: A five-flower spray — green stem and leaves, a purple bell, a teal bloom, a salmon bloom and a white linework layer.
designs.description: A five-flower spray — green stem and leaves, a purple bell, a teal bloom, a salmon bloom and a white linework layer. Tatami fill at 0.4 mm with an edge-run underlay under every shape; 366 trims keep the layers clean on medium-weight woven fabric.

formats.label: PES
formats.note: Brother / Babylock / Bernina (most common home machines)

designs.name: Blue Blossom
designs.summary: A five-petal blossom with a blue gradient and a yellow centre.
designs.description: A five-petal blossom with a blue gradient and a yellow centre. Three thread changes, only 33 trims, and a soft tatami fill — the quickest sew of the four and the easiest to place on a cushion or a placket.

designs.name: Magnolia Branch
designs.summary: A magnolia branch: pink flowers, olive leaves and a dark outline that holds the shape together.
designs.description: A magnolia branch: pink flowers, olive leaves and a dark outline that holds the shape together. Tall and narrow, so it sits well on a kurta placket, a stole end or a sleeve.

designs.name: Silhouette 10
designs.summary: A single-colour silhouette figure holding the number 10 — one thread, ten trims, 3,111 stitches.
designs.description: A single-colour silhouette figure holding the number 10 — one thread, ten trims, 3,111 stitches. Made for jerseys, caps and bags where a clean solid shape is the whole point.
